A '''palace''' belonging to the [[Sith Order]] existed on the Order's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Moraband]]. After arriving on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] during the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Suljo Warde]] settled in the palace, where [[Gender/Legends|he]] kept a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] filled with deranged [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] of the [[Time/Legends|future]].<ref name="Chronicles" />
